_query_doc: Each query:<question> entry below is a list of canned ReAct turns. The fixture builder replays the turns one-by-one, hashing the (system + transcript-so-far) prompt at each step and pairing it with the canned model JSON. Tool results between turns are produced live by query_tools against the populated derived.sqlite, so the test exercises the same code path the production driver does.
